title: Store Actor AI evals
description: Runs every scenario of a Langfuse dataset through an AI agent, judges the results, and returns a Langfuse results link. Defaults run the whole store-actors suite; use the actor filter to run only your Actors.

datasetName.title: Scenario set (Langfuse dataset)
datasetName.description: Name of the Langfuse dataset holding the scenarios. One scenario = one dataset item.

model.title: Model
model.description: The model the agent runs on (OpenRouter id via the Apify proxy; no API key needed). Every model runs inside the Claude Code harness.

categories.title: Only these Actors (optional)
categories.description: Actor slugs to run, e.g. instagram-scraper, crawler-google-places. Matches the scenario's category. Empty = every scenario in the set.

repeats.title: Repeats per scenario
repeats.description: Run each scenario this many times. Use 3 when checking whether a change to your Actor helped; a single run can flip on a flaky scrape.

judge.title: Judge the results
judge.description: Start the Judge Actor when the agents finish so the results link already shows pass/fail and fix areas. Turn off only to re-judge later with a different judge model.

judgeModel.title: Judge model
judgeModel.description: Model that grades the agent runs. Keep it fixed across runs you want to compare.
judgeModel.sectionDescription: Defaults are right for the daily run and for checking your own Actor. Nothing below needs changing for that.

concurrency.title: Parallel agent sessions
concurrency.description: Sessions running at once inside this Actor run. 4 per 4 GB of memory is safe; 16 fits in 8 GB.

perItemTimeoutSecs.title: Per-scenario timeout (seconds)
perItemTimeoutSecs.description: A session past this is killed and judged on what it produced so far.

itemLimit.title: Scenario limit (0 = all)
itemLimit.description: Cap the number of scenarios after filtering. Handy for smoke tests.

mcpUrl.title: MCP server URL
mcpUrl.description: Apify MCP server the agent uses. Each scenario narrows it with ?tools=.

useOpenRouterProxy.title: LLM via Apify OpenRouter proxy
useOpenRouterProxy.description: On the platform this is the only option. Turn off only for local runs with your own Claude login.

harness.title: Harness override (JSON)
harness.description: Advanced: {kind, model, maxTurns}. kind picks the adapter (claude-code only for now). "Model" above overrides model here.

artifactStore.title: Eval artifacts store
artifactStore.description: Named key-value store for full agent logs and tool-schema snapshots. Pick the store named eval-artifacts (id IoT4ipiOnFHyRsZQH); the picker grants this run access. Leave empty to use the default store by name.

langfuseBaseUrl.title: Langfuse base URL override
langfuseBaseUrl.description: Normally set by the Actor's environment. Override only to point at another Langfuse deployment.

langfusePublicKey.title: Langfuse public key override
langfusePublicKey.description: Normally set by the Actor's environment.

langfuseSecretKey.title: Langfuse secret key override
langfuseSecretKey.description: Normally set by the Actor's environment.
